Use your IMAGE GENERATION tool to output ONE PNG. Image generation only — do NOT write or edit code/SVG/files; only generate one image.

Reference IMAGE 1 = the EXACT layout to reproduce (condition.png): every box already shows its title + one description line, arrows are labeled, three pale pastel phase panels on a WHITE background. Reproduce this layout faithfully.

STYLE: top ML-paper "Figure 1" — pure WHITE background, soft pastel phase panels, rounded white node cards, soft shadows, clean thin labeled arrows, crisp sans-serif (monospace for code/number tokens). Hand-designed, not a screenshot.

TEXT IS LOCKED — render every string below VERBATIM and crisp; do NOT rename, paraphrase, add, drop, garble, or insert spaces; do NOT invent any node/term/time-tag:
  - phase "A · Routing fragmentation (diagnosis)"
  - phase "B · Route-Then-Steer (fix)"
  - box "dense: one direction (LRH/CRH)" — "single shared concept direction"
  - box "MoE router" — "fans token to experts E1..E5"
  - box "Frag ≈ 0  (refusal)" — "per-expert arrows collinear"
  - box "Frag high  (medical / legal)" — "per-expert arrows dispersed"
  - box "router (gate)" — "token enters the gate"
  - box "✗ routed away" — "lambda-v sent to non-expressing experts (grey)"
  - box "(1) route (δ)" — "bias router toward expressing experts E_c"
  - box "(2) steer (λ v)" — "add residual concept vector"
  - box "✓ steer lands" — "reaches expressing experts E_c (teal)"
  - arrow router_a→frag_low "collinear"
  - arrow router_a→frag_high "dispersed"
  - arrow router_b→routed_away "no nudge"
  - arrow router_b→route_step "δ"
  - arrow route_step→steer_step "then"
  - arrow steer_step→lands "lands"
  - callout "A concept's steering direction fragments across experts; route-then-steer makes it land": When a concept's per-expert directions disperse (high fragmentation), a residual steer is routed away; biasing the router toward the expressing experts, then steering, makes it land.
  - bottom rail "max 4 rounds | blind cross-model diff | human backstop"
FORBIDDEN — NONE of these terms may appear ANYWHERE in the image (DELETE-list — a competing/wrong name):
  - attention
  - self-attention
  - fine-tune
  - training
